name: download-progress
description: Download files from URLs with resumable downloads and progress updates available to Codex during the task.

interface.shortDescription: Download files and track progress in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Download individual files or batches, view live progress in a local workbench, organize category folders, and export receipts. Safely resume using strong ETags and optionally verify SHA-256.
interface.defaultPrompt: Download this URL with progress updates: <URL>
